description: This Java class defines the OrderGroupAttribute, a subclass of BaseAttribute, representing a user-defined attribute associated with an OrderGroup in the OpenMRS system. It includes fields and methods for managing the attribute's ID and its association with an OrderGroup, with annotations indicating it is audited.

classes.name: OrderGroupAttribute
classes.description: Represents a user-defined attribute linked to an OrderGroup, extending BaseAttribute with specific getters and setters for its identifier and associated OrderGroup.

methods.name: getOrderGroupAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the OrderGroupAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderGroupAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the OrderGroupAttribute.

methods.name: setOrderGroup
methods.description: Associates an OrderGroup object with this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the attribute's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the attribute's ID.
